name: Rodauth

evidence.library: F02: embedded Ruby account framework that runs in the app process; F05: developer operates app and tables

line: Ruby account and login toolkit with passkey support.

cells.freeUsers: No licence user cap; you host
cells.sso: No connection meter; SAML/OIDC use separate gems
